Hero portraits are game artwork from Garena's public Liên Quân website.
Source URLs, IDs and names were supplied by the user's workbook
“tuong_lien_quan_ID_hoan_chinh.xlsx”. Workbook SHA-256 and per-file image
SHA-256/URL attribution are recorded in Assets/HeroIcons/catalog.json.
All rights in the artwork remain with their respective owners.
130 source images are bundled unmodified (including one GIF); UIKit selects
the displayed image and clips it at runtime. No game-time downloads.

Menu background artwork: Violet Thu Nguyen Ve Than (SSS), Violet Nobara
Kugisaki and Tulen Satoru Gojo (collaborations), from official Garena pages:
https://lienquan.garena.vn/hoc-vien/tuong-skin/d/violet/
https://lienquan.garena.vn/hoc-vien/tuong-skin/d/tulen/
Exact image URLs and SHA-256 are in Assets/Theme/manifest.json.
The app background/floating button photo was supplied by the user; its
original bytes are bundled unchanged, with display cropping performed by UI.
Motion effects are implemented in the menu; artwork is not a video.
